caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) across several epochs during the fine-tuning of a Whisper model. The x-axis is labeled 'epoch' and is linear, ranging from 0 to 6 with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled 'WER' and is linear, ranging from approximately 19.5 to 28, with regularly spaced tick labels every 2 units. A line is shown in gray with a solid line style and triangular markers; this line starts at approximately 28.1 at epoch 0, decreases to approximately 23.9 at epoch 2, and declines to approximately 21.6 at epoch 6. A second line is shown in blue with a dashed line style and circular markers; this line starts at approximately 21.8 at epoch 0, decreases to approximately 19.6 at epoch 2, and declines to approximately 19.2 at epoch 6.
